claims.assertion: A bullish Wolfe Wave is a descending converging wedge of five points (P3 below P1, P4 below P2) with the P1-P4 line extended as the target and the stop beyond P5.

external_sources.title: Bulkowski, Bullish Wolfe Wave
external_sources.says: Identification rules (P4 below P2, lines 1-3 and 2-4 must converge, P5 need not bottom on line 1-3, no other higher peak or lower valley between points); statistics on 6,269 stock patterns, daily; 47% meet the EPA under 'perfect trades' (entry at the exact point-5 low) which the page says cannot be duplicated; rank 34 of 39.

external_sources.title: LuxAlgo library: Wolfe Waves
external_sources.says: Rules and a recommended confirmation bar closing back inside line 1-3; states no rigorous public statistics exist and that loose rules find waves everywhere in hindsight; does not address repainting.

external_sources.title: ATAS: Wolfe Wave guide
external_sources.says: Entry at point 5 with nuances, Wolfe gave no strict stop rule, target is the 1-4 line, no accuracy figures, subjective recognition.

external_sources.title: Quantum Algo: Wolfe Wave guide
external_sources.says: Cites Bulkowski as 41% bullish and 35% bearish reaching the EPA; this does not match Bulkowski's own headline of 47%.

concepts.name: Wolfe Wave
concepts.plain_language: Five alternating swing points form a converging wedge. The fifth point overshoots the wedge's lower boundary; the idea is that price then returns toward the line drawn from point 1 through point 4.

rules.pivots: P1 low, P2 high, P3 low, P4 high, P5 low, all confirmed (bullish); bearish is the mirror
rules.wedge: P3 < P1, P4 < P2, P3 < P4 < P2; the 1-3 and 2-4 lines converge
rules.overshoot: P5 below the 1-3 line and below P3
rules.entry: close of the bar that confirms P5 (right bars after P5)
rules.target: P1-P4 line extended, read target_horizon_bars after P5

configurable_disagreements: Entry trigger: at P5 vs only after a break of the 1-3 line (sources differ). Implemented: P5 confirmation. PLANNED: break-of-line mode.
Target timing: sources give no single time rule (target_horizon_bars).
invalidation: price closes below the P5 stop
concepts.entry: Video: 'ENTRY LONG' just above P5. Code: close of the P5 confirmation bar plus spread.
concepts.stop_loss: Video: red STOP-LOSS at the P5 level. Code: P5 price.
concepts.target: Video: point 6 on the P1-P4 line. Code: that line evaluated target_horizon_bars after P5.
concepts.repaint_risk: None after confirmation: pivots are only known right bars after they form; a candidate is emitted at P5 confirmation using no later data. Before confirmation P5 is unknowable.
failure_modes: wedge continues lower after P5 (no reversal)
target line projection time is arbitrary
hindsight drawing bias in teaching examples
pivot window changes which points exist
